jobs.occupation: Senior Physical Security Specialist (f/m/d) (Fachkraft - Schutz und Sicherheit)
jobs.description:
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place?
Then become a playmaker and join our team as Senior Physical Security Specialist (f/m/d) at E.ON Digital Technology.
We play a key role in shaping the energy transition by leading E.ON's digital transformation across Europe. We explore new paths by developing ideas, breaking new ground, making visions reality, and bringing new technologies to life. We deliver sustainable technology solutions because…
… it’s on us to make new energy work!

The Team – your impact
You are a member of the Crisis Management undamp; Physical Security Coordination team. Together with your colleagues you coordinate and continuously develop the physical security organization to protect our critical infrastructures, facilities, people and operating processes at E.ON.
Your Role – meaningful undamp; rewarding

- Develop and drive a group-wide, risk-based physical security framework, including policies, standards, and methodologies for asset protection
- Ensure implementation and continuous improvement of site security concepts across all business segments and locations
- Conduct and oversee risk and threat assessments (e.g., sabotage, vandalism, espionage, unauthorized access) and define mitigation measures
- Manage and support tendering and procurement of security services, ensuring high quality and cost efficiency
- Advise on security requirements for new sites, buildings, and leases, including technical and personnel security solutions
- Define and standardize on-site security operations (e.g., reception, gatekeeping) in collaboration with Corporate Real Estate Management
- Plan and support executive and high-profile event security, including coordination of protection measures
- Contribute to executive protection activities in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
- Monitor, evaluate, and report security incidents, ensuring effective response and continuous improvement
- Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance security capabilities
Your Profile – authentic undamp; open-minded
- Extensive professional experience in Physical Security within a corporate or complex operational environment
- Strong expertise in physical security technologies and systems, frameworks, and relevant standards (e.g., ISO 27001)
- Solid understanding of IT and OT environments, including grid/energy infrastructure (EIS assets), operations, and design
- Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions
- Strategic mindset combined with strong business acumen and understanding of risk and value creation
- Confident in decision-making with a strong sense of accountability, able to act effectively under pressure and with incomplete information
- Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative and cross-functional approach
- Professional certification such as CPP, PSP, or CPO is a strong advantage
- Fluency in English and German (written and spoken)
- Valid driver’s license (Class B)
Our Benefits – smart undamp; useful​
- Recharge your battery: You have 30 days of paid vacation per year plus Christmas and New Year's Eve off. Your battery still needs charging? You can exchange parts of your salary for more paid vacation or you can take a sabbatical.​
- Advance your development: We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, exchanging with others, or taking part in an individual training – our learning culture enables you to bring your personal and professional development to the next level.​
- Enjoy hybrid work: We combine office collaboration with focused work from home. It’s also possible to go on workation for up to 20 days per year within Europe.​​
- Stay active undamp; healthy: Benefit from a company-sponsored health membership.​
- Elevate your mobility: From car and bike leasing offers to a subsidised Deutschland-Ticket – your way is our way.​
- Think ahead: With our company pension scheme and a great insurance package we take care of your future.​
- This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.

Do you have questions?
For further information please contact the Talent Acquisition Team, ­EDT_Talent_Acquisition@eon.com.
Please understand that for data protection reasons we can only accept applications submitted via our portal. Unfortunately, we cannot consider application documents that reach us by email or post.

jobs.occupation: Senior Ethics und Compliance Officer (d/f/m) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility. We provide engineering that keeps the world moving, including design, installation, and maintenance of elevators, escalators, walkways, lifts, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators – including multi-brand modernization and service any place, any time. With TK Elevator’s AI and digital solutions there are no longer any limits to urban mobility. TK Elevator became independent following its separation from the thyssenkrupp group in 2020. The company achieved sales of €9.2 billion in fiscal year 2024/2025. With around 50,000 employees, 25,000 service technicians and over 1,000 support centers globally, we are moved by what moves people. TKE – Move Beyond.

What we expect

- You will promote TK Elevator’s compliance culture and compliance awareness worldwide in close coordination with the regional compliance organization
- You will support the further development and implementation of the TK Elevator compliance strategy, with a focus on preventive measures, processes, tools, and digital solutions
- You will identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks in the global elevator business, particularly in the area of antitrust law
- You will advise corporate functions and business units in a pragmatic, risk-oriented, and business-focused manner on compliance with applicable laws and internal guidelines
- You monitor legal and regulatory developments, assess their impact, and derive practical recommendations
- You will take on responsibility in international projects, work flexibly on changing compliance priorities, and bring an affinity for IT-supported and AI-based work methods

Who we are looking for

- You have relevant qualifications and experience in the field of compliance, ideally a law degree with in-depth knowledge of antitrust law
- You have at least 5 years of professional experience in a company, a compliance role, or a law firm specializing in commercial law
- You possess high ethical standards, sound judgment, and enjoy collaborating in a diverse, international environment
- You are characterized by strong communication skills, positive energy, flexibility, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented “can-do” attitude
- You work confidently in a matrix organization and interact successfully with various stakeholders
- You have a strong affinity for digital tools, IT-supported processes, and AI applications
- And last but not least, you are fluent in English and German

What we offer

It goes without saying, that we offer attractive conditions such as: 
Working in a successful organization with lean hierarchies and all the advantages of an international group. 
With us, you experience an exciting work environment in interdisciplinary and multinational teams. 
Very good development opportunities either in a specialist or in a management function. 
An attractive remuneration including special benefits according to the collective agreement NRW.

Contact

Please apply online in English including your salary expectation and your notice period. 
Bianca Wickinghoff
Talent Acquisition

Additional information

At TK Elevator, we aim to embrace diversity and welcome everyone -no matter the ethnicity, nationality, gender or gender expression, age, social background, religion or world belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. 
Do you have a disability and would like to work with us? Then we look forward to your application! 
As a signatory of the Charter of Diversity, TK Elevator is committed to a prejudice-free and diverse working environment with equal opportunities. Although we are not completely barrier-free yet, we are working every day to improve ourselves. Let’s overcome barriers together and work on individual solutions that work for you.

jobs.occupation: PhD candidate (f/m/d) (Molekularbiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description:
The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.

We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)

This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.

You will be responsible for

- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response
- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production
- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples
- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets
- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations
- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis
- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context
- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partners

Your profile

- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines
- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage
- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions
- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable
- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required
- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking
- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment
- Fluent in spoken and written English

We offer

- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association
- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team
- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms
- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network
- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops
- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications
- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits
- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family service

Non-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.

The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).

jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Manager (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Deutsche Telekom, we don’t just connect people; we build the cognitive digital infrastructure of the future. Within our Group Technology – Technology Vendor Portfolio Management unit, we steer the high-impact alliances that drive next-generation innovation. As networks transform into self-optimizing, cloud-native ecosystems, we are embedding artificial intelligence and automation into our core infrastructure.
Are you a visionary strategist who understands how AI and next-gen telecom tech converge? Do you have the executive presence to operate alongside industry leaders? Join us and lead our technology partner ecosystem into the age of intelligent connectivity.

Your Responsibilities: What You Will Do

As a Senior Partner Manager (m/w/d), you will take full ownership of relationship building and lifecycle management at the C-level and Top-Management level, both internally across the DT Group and externally with global tech leaders.

- Executive Relationship & C-Level Management: Act as the primary strategic interface, establishing and nurturing high-impact relationships with executive stakeholders and C-level counterparts.
- AI-Driven Infrastructure Innovation: Define future demand by identifying joint search fields, advanced automation use cases, and AI-centric network initiatives.
- Matrix & Cross-Group Project Responsibility: Take end-to-end project and program leadership for large-scale partner initiatives—from high-stakes negotiation to commercialization and retirement. You will steer complex, virtual, and international project teams across the global DT Group without direct disciplinary responsibility.
- Commercial & Financial Governance: Develop robust business plans, align complex financial planning activities, set up partner governance, and define KPIs to ensure mutual success.
- Performance Monitoring: Drive executive-level steering presentations, closely monitor target achievement, and coordinate the internal rollout of partner products.

Your Profile: What You Bring

You are a highly analytical professional who bridges the gap between complex network technology, business economics, and future-ready AI applications.
Qualifications & Core Experience:

- Education: A university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Communication Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, or a comparable qualification.
- Track Record: At least 7 to 10 years of proven professional experience in Strategic Partner Management, Alliance Management, or Tech Procurement within the telecommunications sector.
- Telecom Infrastructure Expertise: Deep, long-standing experience in partner management for network infrastructures, including Mobile (5G/6G), Fixed-Line, IP & Transport, Core Network, Service Platforms, and Cloud, specifically mapping to Deutsche Telekom's ecosystem.
- Future-Tech Literacy: A strong understanding of the business potential of Artificial Intelligence, machine learning applications in networking, and automation trends, allowing you to identify cutting-edge tech trends.

Skills & Competencies:

- Virtual Team Steering: Exceptional track record in organizing, motivating, and leading large-scale programs within virtual, international, and matrixed teams across multiple corporate stakeholders.
- Agile & Classic Cooperation: Mastery of both classical and agile project management methodologies to coordinate cross-functional programs.
- Intercultural Competence: Extensive experience navigating international business landscapes and managing senior executive relationships across diverse cultures.
- Analytical Power: Outstanding conceptual and analytical skills with a collaborative, solution-oriented working style.
- **Languages: **Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory for this high-level role.

What We Offer (Why Deutsche Telekom?)

- Hybrid Work: Flexible working hours and state-of-the-art mobile working options based out of our headquarters in Bonn.
- AI & Tech Innovation: Work at the absolute forefront of network intelligence, automation, and infrastructure evolution.
- High-Level Exposure: Drive visibility at the top-management level across one of Europe’s leading telco providers.
- Compensation & Benefits: Highly competitive salary package, extensive company pension scheme, and employee discounts on Telekom products.

Ready to connect?
We look forward to receiving your application! Please submit your CV and cover letter online via our career portal.
Your contact: anyue.gao@telekom.de

Deutsche Telekom is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and look forward to receiving applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, or age.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As part of our team, you will be responsible for auxiliary systems for generators in power plants and synchronous condenser applications of customer projects. Almost every day will be different – some days you will be able to focus on your planned tasks. On other days, you will be challenged with operational topics which lead to interaction with internal colleagues, suppliers or customers. Therefore, you will have to shift your priorities at a moment’s notice to support urgent, unplanned work packages, like supporting commissioning tasks or resolving site issues. Either way, you will collaborate with a global cross-organizational team with different technical and cultural backgrounds. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Being responsible for the complete order execution process of generator auxiliary systems
* Creating and configuring system P&ID in our engineering suite COMOS including all related meta data and supporting lists, ensuring that the project requirements and customer expectations are fulfilled
* Closing interaction and cooperation with our colleagues from supply management as well as our external skid suppliers to ensure specification compliance
* Ensuring “in budget” & “in schedule” order execution from project start to end of warranty period and final inspections at the skid suppliers’ workshop prior to shipment
* Interacting with internal interface partners like I&C, electrical engineering, piping & layout planning and project management, as well as with external interface partners like EPCs and customers
* Answering customer letters and support project management in customer clarifications and meetings

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in the field of process engineering, mechanical engineering, or a comparable discipline
* Some years of professional experience and good knowledge in at least one of the above-mentioned disciplines
* Experience in a process industry-related environment (e.g. power generation, oil and gas) is beneficial
* Very good knowledge of German and English, both written and spoken is required
* Enjoying developing innovative solutions in interdisciplinary and international teams, as well as understanding customer requirements and developing concepts & solutions
* Analytical attitude and detailed work approach 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Business Continuity Officer (f/m/d) (Chief Operating Officer)
jobs.description:
You have a passion for technology and want to make the world a greener place?
Then become a playmaker and join our team as Business Continuity Officer (f/m/d) at E.ON Digital Technology.
We play a key role in shaping the energy transition by leading E.ON's digital transformation across Europe. We explore new paths by developing ideas, breaking new ground, making visions reality, and bringing new technologies to life. We deliver sustainable technology solutions because…
… it’s on us to make new energy work!

The Team – your impact
You are a member of the Business Continuity Management (BCM) team, acting as second line of defense for Business Continuity across the Business Units (BU). Together with your colleagues, you ensure that continuity risks are identified, managed, and mitigated in a consistent and effective manner. Business Continuity encompasses the resilience of all business processes, including the underlying Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT), as well as assets, operations, suppliers, employees, and facilities.
Your Role – meaningful undamp; rewarding

- Act as the primary contact for Business Continuity within the Business Unit
- Coordinate the implementation of group BCM policies and standards
- Provide advice and guidance on Business Continuity topics to the Business Unit
- Conduct and coordinate Business Impact Analyses (BIA) with process owners to identify critical processes and dependencies
- Coordinate and support internal and external BCM audits, including remediation of findings
- Drive the continuous improvement of the BCM framework
- Develop and steer BCM roadmaps and maturity development
- Ensure that Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery tests are planned and executed
- Coordinate and align Business, IT, OT and Service Continuity to ensure Business Continuity activities (like BIAs and tests) run smoothly and consistently
- Develop and maintain emergency and contingency plans (e.g., pandemics, natural disasters)
- Support the Crisis Management Support Team with Business Continuity Plans (BCPs)
- Design and implement BCM awareness initiatives and training programs
- Report on BCM maturity and roadmap progress to BU Board and VP BCM
- Manage and document incident reporting and emergency procedures, ensuring alignment across key stakeholders (e.g., ISO, DPO, IT Head, OT Head)
Your Profile – authentic undamp; open-minded
- Several years of professional experience in Business Continuity Management in matrix organizations and/or functional organizations
- Strong track record in implementing BCM programs at scale
- Operational experience across diverse business functions
- Strong understanding of IT/OT service continuity and disaster recovery concepts (e.g. RTO/RPO, resilience patterns)
- Expert knowledge of ISO 22301 and basic understanding of ISO27001, 27019 and 27031
- Relevant BCM/ Resilience certification such as CBCI, ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or equivalent
- Good understanding of grid/energy systems, IT and OT environments
- High ownership and decision-making capability, even under uncertainty
- Excellent communication and influencing skills across stakeholders
- Strategic thinking who connects big-picture goals with practical execution
- Strong business acumen with understanding of value, risk, and operations
- Fluent in English and local language (written and spoken)
- Valid driver’s license (Class B)
Our Benefits – smart undamp; useful​
- Recharge your battery: You have 30 days of paid vacation per year plus Christmas and New Year's Eve off. Your battery still needs charging? You can exchange parts of your salary for more paid vacation or you can take a sabbatical.​
- Advance your development: We grow and we want you to grow with us. Learning on the job, exchanging with others, or taking part in an individual training – our learning culture enables you to bring your personal and professional development to the next level.​
- Enjoy hybrid work: We combine office collaboration with focused work from home. It’s also possible to go on workation for up to 20 days per year within Europe.​​
- Stay active undamp; healthy: Benefit from a company-sponsored health membership.​
- Elevate your mobility: From car and bike leasing offers to a subsidised Deutschland-Ticket – your way is our way.​
- Think ahead: With our company pension scheme and a great insurance package we take care of your future.​
- This is by far not all… We are looking forward to speaking with you about further benefits during the hiring process.

Do you have questions?
For further information please contact the Talent Acquisition Team, ­EDT_Talent_Acquisition@eon.com.
Please understand that for data protection reasons we can only accept applications submitted via our portal. Unfortunately, we cannot consider application documents that reach us by email or post.
What you need to know:
Job Req ID: 244530
Contract type: Permanent

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Corporate Commodity Expert (f/m/d) in Supplier Quality & Development (SQD) you drive technical and quality topics within the corporate managed commodity Machined Parts across Siemens Energy’s all business areas and x-functions. You influence supplier decisions and work with suppliers to develop them and the commodity in alignment with Siemens Energy's needs for capacity, capability, and lowest total cost.  

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Technical counterpart to Corporate Commodity Management for commodity strategy development, supplier identification, early supplier involvement, and technology scouting and implementation in Machined Parts commodity 
* Establishment and transfer of state-of-the-art manufacturing technology expertise, methods, and processes across all Siemens Energy business areas and support business areas with expertise where needed. 
* Development and implementation of global commodity technology roadmaps and technological improvement measures for Machined Parts
* Execution of supplier capability assessments, supplier qualification audits, management system approvals, and implementation of global quality assurance agreements for strategic suppliers 
* Identification and harmonization of manufacturing, material, and cost drivers as well as technical specifications to enable high-performing global supply chains 
* Technical leadership in supplier development, strategic issue resolution, and manufacturing/material technology expertise within the Siemens Energy supply chain for Machined Parts 

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline combined with relevant senior-level professional experience 
* Extensive Professional expertise in supplier quality management and manufacturing engineering, with proven specific subject matter expertise in machining and related manufacturing technologies. 
* Demonstrated experience in supplier qualification (lead auditor preferred), product and process qualification, and technical supplier development for globally competitive and quality-assured supply chains 
* Project management experience and leadership of international cross-functional and virtual teams with an ownership mindset and strong stakeholder skills. 
* International mobility and willingness to travel globally up to 30% 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English 

About the Team

n our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

We are Covestro. We are curious. We are courageous. We are colorful. We refine chemical material solutions with game-changing products. Let us empower you to push boundaries. Join us and our 18.000 colleagues now and together we will make the world a brighter place.

Shape the digital identity of tomorrow with us

You want to make a real technological impact at a globally operating chemical company? At Covestro, we combine a drive for innovation with a clear commitment to sustainability – and we're looking for people who embody both.

As a Microsoft Active Directory Architect (m/f/d) in our Identity and Access Management team, you will play a key role in advancing our digital identity infrastructure. You will shape how Covestro accesses its systems securely and efficiently across the globe – with real creative latitude, direct collaboration with leadership bodies and global partners, and an environment that values technical depth just as much as out-of-the-box thinking.

In addition to our diverse benefits, a full-time position comes with an attractive starting salary between €89,400/year and €108,500/year plus a variable component. The starting salary is based on your qualifications and professional experience.

What awaits you in this role:

- You develop strategy, technical design and architectural guidelines for our company-wide IAM and Active Directory environment
- Together with your IAM colleagues, you drive the transformation to modern identity and directory technologies – including shared ownership of relevant roadmap workstreams and regular communication of status and progress
- Identifying innovative technology solutions that reduce costs, increase efficiency and minimise risks is equally part of your responsibilities
- You support engineering and operations teams through targeted expert guidance during the implementation of developed solutions
- In close collaboration with Audit, Risk, Compliance and Security teams, you address open items and consistently prioritise necessary remediation measures
- Through presentations, workshops and the creation of content, you actively contribute to knowledge sharing around IAM standards and best practices

What you bring to the table:

- A completed university degree in information technology as well as deep expertise in Microsoft Active Directory, DNS and relevant Microsoft technologies
- Strong expertise in integrating on-premises AD with cloud environments such as MS Entra ID for hybrid identity management
- Proficiency in PowerShell or comparable scripting languages for automation and audit queries
- Experience with multi-factor authentication, privileged account management and ideally IT/OT architectures – preferably from the chemical industry
- Relevant certifications (Identity and Access Administrator, CISSP or CISM) are a clear advantage
- Strong communication and influencing skills as well as the ability to independently learn new technologies and act in a solution-oriented manner under pressure
- Good German language skills and fluent English, both written and spoken

This position is generally to be filled on a full-time basis. Would you like to work part-time? Feel free to apply in this case as well, stating your desired percentage.

For initial questions, Chris Rziha (chris.rziha@covestro.com (https://mailto:chris.rziha@covestro.com) ) is happy to help.

Please do not use this email address to send your application or CV. To apply, please click the "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.

jobs.occupation: Senior Specialist Global Functional Process Owner O2C - Finance (m/f/d) (Finanzwirt/in)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In the Coatings division, we offer far more than just paints and coatings. Our approach is to put the needs of our customers at the center and always think one step ahead. Our motto ‘We always go beyond the surface' makes it clear that we are not only focused on the products themselves, but also on the reasons why we develop them. We are interested in creating innovative solutions that promote future growth and fulfil the requirements of the market. With our extensive knowledge and experience, we work to provide tailored coatings solutions that create real value and build strong partnerships.

Due to the strategic realignment of the Coatings business unit, a dedicated finance department is being established. This presents an exciting opportunity to develop and shape the finance organization from its foundation. Therefore, we are looking for a Senior Specialist Global Functional Process Owner Order-to-Cash Finance with the following objectives:

- You own the global Order-to-cash (O2C) Finance processes, which includes Customer Master Data, Invoicing and Billing, Cash Applications, Collections, Dunning & Accounts Receivable Management.
- You establish and maintain global standards for Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, ensuring these are aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements across the coatings division.
- Moreover, you oversee the O2C activities, identify and drive process improvement opportunities, leveraging technology and digital solutions to enhance automation, efficiency, and continuous improvement within the finance organization.
- You manage a third-party business process provider in the area of O2C and will implement process performance KPIs to steer the service provider.
- In addition, collaborate closely with related functions such as P2P and B2R, you will coordinate integration efforts and you will ensure holistic alignment of financial processes.
- Last but not least, you engage with internal stakeholders to ensure that O2C processes meet business needs and support strategic objectives.
- university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; additional certifications such as CMA or CPA are an advantage
- at least 10 years of work experience in financial process management and optimization, with a strong focus on O2C activities in a multinational corporation
- experience in the chemicals industry or related industry, particularly during transitions or carve-outs, is highly beneficial
- strong understanding of O2C processes and process optimization methodologies
- proficiency in SAP R/3 and S/4, process mapping tools, and advanced MS Office skills
- excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders in a multicultural environment
- fluency in English is required
- We offer an attractive salary with individual benefits such as performance-related bonuses or a share program. Company-funded supplementary health insurance, accident insurance and an attractive pension plan offer comprehensive coverage.
- We offer a wide range of local and global development and career opportunities for professional and personal development.
- As a founding member of the Diversity Charter, BASF stands for diversity - we are proud of our Coatings employee networks WomenInCoatings, ColorPride@EC and CultiConnect.
- The feedback culture is firmly integrated into our corporate culture, e.g. through regular employee surveys and management feedback.
- At our location in Münster, we have our own fitness studio "Freizeit" with a physiotherapy practice, permanently employed company doctors, a company restaurant "Auszeit" including a café bar, a bilingual company daycare center "LackiKids" and a vacation program "LackiKids on Tour".
- We have 30 vacation days/year (full-time), additional time off options and a 37.5-hour week.
